recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-36751; implementation guides needing R5 attester semantics in R4 should use the appropriate cross-version/backport mechanism rather than reintroducing authenticator into current core.
issue_request: FHIR-36751 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core DocumentReference and asked to change R4 DocumentReference.authenticator from 0..1 to 0..* for C-CDA cases with multiple legally responsible people. The resolution said no changes were needed because the R5 attester element already has 0..* cardinality.
initial_application: No source commit tagged FHIR-36751 was found. The R5 source rework commit 33b409a4b6 already introduced DocumentReference.attester as a 0..* BackboneElement before this issue was created, and OO minutes for the FHIR-36751 vote recorded it as already fixed with work on .attester.
additional_context: FHIR-25087 is the earlier same-change-family Published request to support multiple DocumentReference authenticators by aligning with Composition.attester. FHIR-34160 later clarified the attester definition to use authenticated language, and current attester.party includes the relevant person/organization targets. Later non-core IG/backport issues found during the search do not change current FHIR-core source scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini lists DocumentReference as an active resource and maps DocumentReference.authenticator to DocumentReference.attester; current source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml defines DocumentReference.attester with min 0 and max *, and source search found no active DocumentReference.authenticator element to widen.
